justification: The Intelligence Brief page was a bare input card while the Conveyancing page has a full product landing (hero, data sources, what-it-covers, methodology). This gives the Brief the same landing using the existing ProductLandingV2 config pattern: a new intelligence-brief config, optional pricing in the landing types (the Brief is free, so no invented price table), idle-state mounting on the brief page, a landing-search listener so the hero's address input starts a brief, and route metadata via a new layout. Also: canibuildit no longer serves the two pro report pages (307 to their subdomains), and the branch merges main to pick up #642's point-in-polygon strata fix (the Brief imports detect_strata from the conveyancing script, so the Bowral wrong-strata bug is fixed here too); the duplicate GIT_DIR scrub both branches carried in qa_gate was deduplicated to main's version.

pre_impl.existing_data: ProductLandingV2 renders a landing from per-product configs (7 existed: flood, shadow, solar, threat-radar, pre-da, bushfire, conveyancing). LandingHero already dispatches a window 'landing-search' CustomEvent with the typed address. The brief page is a 1900-line client component with idle/triggering/streaming/complete states and a POST /api/intelligence-brief trigger where lat/lng are optional (server resolves). The Brief's strata classification imports detect_strata from scripts/generate_conveyancing_report.py — fixed on main in #642.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The landing config type required a price + free/paid comparison table; the Brief has no paid tier today, and inventing one would fabricate pricing. Made pricing optional and render the methodology block standalone.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new mechanism: one new config file following data/conveyancing.ts, one new metadata layout following the conveyancing page's metadata (the brief page is 'use client' so metadata cannot live there), and wiring inside the existing page state machine. The trigger body was extracted from handleGenerate into startBrief(address, lat, lng) so the landing event and the button share one code path.

functions.name: intelligenceBriefConfig
functions.input: none - a static exported config object consumed by ProductLandingV2 via its product-key record
functions.output: hero copy, 6 data sources, 9 feature cards mirroring the brief's streamed sections, methodology text; no price and no comparison (free product)
functions.if_none: key missing from the configs record -> ProductLandingV2 returns null and the page falls back to the plain input card

functions.name: ProductLandingV2
functions.input: product key -> config; config.price/config.comparison now optional
functions.output: renders PricingTable only when price AND comparison exist; otherwise a standalone How It Works block with config.methodology
functions.if_none: config absent -> null (unchanged); all 7 existing configs still define price+comparison so their rendering is unchanged

functions.name: startBrief / handleGenerate / landing-search effect
functions.input: startBrief(address, lat|null, lng|null); the effect reads CustomEvent detail.address with optional chaining
functions.output: same POST body and state transitions as before; the landing hero submit starts a brief with lat/lng null (server resolves); the button path passes the autocomplete's lat/lng exactly as before
functions.if_none: empty/missing event address -> ignored; event while a brief is running (stateRef !== 'idle') -> ignored; listener removed on unmount

functions.name: IntelligenceBriefLayout
functions.input: the route's children (the client brief page), passed through untouched
functions.output: route metadata (title/OG/twitter) + SoftwareAppJsonLd, then children unchanged
functions.if_none: no conditional paths - a static server wrapper with no data fetching or state

functions.name: middleware
functions.input: the incoming NextRequest; host resolved via x-forwarded-host, then host, then nextUrl.hostname (same chain the existing domain rules use)
functions.output: on the canibuildit host, /reports/intelligence-brief 307-redirects to https://brief.plotdetect.com.au and /reports/conveyancing to https://conveyance.plotdetect.com.au, preserving the query string; every other host and path is untouched
functions.if_none: host is not canibuildit or path is any other route -> falls through to the existing rewrite and API rules exactly as before

functions.name: changed_line_numbers
functions.input: git args; subprocess env scrubbed of GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, GIT_INDEX_FILE (deduplicated to main's #642 version after the merge)
functions.output: git runs against cwd=project_dir as intended, instead of the hook's exported repo location
functions.if_none: git fails or no merge-base -> returns None/{} -> gate keeps ALL findings (unchanged fail-safe full-scan fallback)

values: N/A - no regulatory values. The landing copy deliberately carries no LGA counts or control numbers (hero stats are '15+ data layers', '~40 sec typical brief', 'Live NSW Planning Portal'); liability grep on the new copy returned zero matches.

break_it.scenario: landing hero submits a free-typed address that never went through autocomplete (no lat/lng, possibly garbage)
break_it.what_happens: the brief is triggered with lat/lng null; a bad address makes the run fail
break_it.repro: type 'asdf' in the hero and submit
break_it.how: the API contract already declares lat/lng optional and resolves server-side; a failed run lands in the existing visible error state with 'Try another address' - a loud failure, not wrong data

break_it.scenario: landing-search fires while a brief is already streaming (stale landing state, double submit)
break_it.what_happens: a second run would clobber the in-flight one
break_it.how: the listener checks stateRef.current !== 'idle' and ignores the event; the landing itself unmounts once state leaves idle

break_it.scenario: making pricing optional breaks the seven existing landings
break_it.what_happens: their pricing tables would disappear or crash on undefined
break_it.how: render is gated on config.price && config.comparison, and all seven existing configs still define both; tsc clean and all 713 jest tests pass

break_it.scenario: a consumer mid-brief on canibuildit gets redirected and loses their run, or the redirect gets stuck in browser cache
break_it.what_happens: in-flight state is lost on the domain hop; a cached permanent redirect would be hard to undo later
break_it.how: the redirect fires before the page loads (no run can be in flight on that URL), uses 307 (temporary, not cached like the 308s that made a past domain move painful), and the destination subdomain root rewrites to the same page - the user lands on the identical product, pro-branded

break_it.scenario: the merge stacking two copies of the qa_gate env scrub reintroduces the worktree push failure or shadows one fix
break_it.what_happens: duplicate env assignments could drift apart and silently reintroduce the GIT_DIR leak
break_it.repro: push from a git worktree so hooks export an absolute GIT_DIR
break_it.how: deduplicated to main's single copy (#642); the previously failing test passes with an absolute GIT_DIR exported and the full pytest suite (2479) passes post-merge

break_it.scenario: duplicate H1 / competing address inputs when the landing and the classic input card render together
break_it.what_happens: confusing double title and two entry points styled differently
break_it.how: the compact page header now renders only when state !== 'idle' (the hero carries the title while idle), matching the conveyancing page's landing-plus-tool layout; the classic card keeps the satellite toggle the hero lacks

break_it.scenario: User starts a brief from the landing hero search and wants satellite layers (the hero previously had no toggle, so hero-started briefs always ran with satellite off and the option looked removed)
break_it.what_happens: the satellite checkbox now renders directly under the hero search bar via the searchExtras slot; the landing-search handler reads the live includeSatellite state so a hero-started brief honours the tick
break_it.how: searchExtras threaded LandingHero <- ProductLandingV2 <- page.tsx bound to the existing includeSatellite state; startBrief's useCallback dep on includeSatellite rebinds the landing-search listener on toggle
break_it.repro: open /reports/intelligence-brief while idle: the 'Include satellite analysis' checkbox is visible under the hero search; tick it, run from the hero, network POST body has include_satellite: true
